properties.description: Post-migration validation pipeline. Compares file counts and sizes between SharePoint source and ADLS destination for each migrated library. Generates validation report and flags discrepancies.

sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT Id, SiteUrl, LibraryName, FileCount AS ExpectedFileCount, TotalSizeBytes AS ExpectedSizeBytes
FROM dbo.MigrationControl
WHERE Status = 'Completed'
AND (@{if(pipeline().parameters.ValidateAll, 1, 0)} = 1 OR ValidationStatus IS NULL OR ValidationStatus = 'Pending')

datasetSettings.description: Dataset for the migration control table containing SharePoint sites and libraries to migrate with status tracking.

sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS ActualFileCount,
    SUM(FileSizeBytes) AS ActualSizeBytes,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MigrationStatus = 'Success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SuccessCount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MigrationStatus = 'Failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FailedCount
FROM dbo.MigrationAuditLog
WHERE SourcePath LIKE '@{item().SiteUrl}/@{item().LibraryName}%'

datasetSettings.description: Dataset for the per-file audit log tracking individual file migration status, checksums, and errors.

source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN ValidationStatus = 'Validated' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ValidatedCount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ValidationStatus = 'Discrepancy' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DiscrepancyCount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ValidationStatus IS NULL OR ValidationStatus = 'Pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PendingCount,
    COUNT(*) AS TotalLibraries
FROM dbo.MigrationControl
WHERE Status = 'Completed'

datasetSettings.description: Dataset for the migration control table containing SharePoint sites and libraries to migrate with status tracking.
